```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
library(gtsummary)
library(ggplot2)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(haven)
library(labelled)
library(ggmosaic)
library(gt)
library(dplyr)
library(gtsummary)
library(flextable)
```

```{r readdata, echo = F, include = F}
# load data set
empro <- here::here("EMPRO_data_20221219.RData")
load(empro)

#make enrollment month factor 
empro_data$enrollment_month1 = factor(empro_data$enrollment_month)

#make new variable for yes/no CRPC
empro_data$crpc_per = empro_data$cohort != "mHSPC"

#relabel new vars
var_label(empro_data) <- list(
  crpc_per = "Percent CRPC (vs.mHSPC)", enrollment_month1 = "Study visit at entry")
```


### **Table 1:** Characteristics of patients in the intervention group and proxy control group

```{r}
#create demographic table by invention and control (arm variable = groups)
empro_data %>%
  dplyr::select(arm,
         country,
         age_baseline,
         race_gp,
         diag_enroll,
         year_emp_enrollment,
         enrollment_month1,
         crpc_per,
         education,
         yn_eortc_0,
         yn_eortc_3,
         yn_eortc_6,
         yn_eortc_9,
         yn_eortc_12,
         dead) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = arm,
              missing = "ifany",
              missing_text = "N missing",
              type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
              statistic = all_continuous() ~ c("{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                                               "{min}, {max}")) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_header(label = "",stat_1 = "**Proxy Control** N = {n}", 
                           stat_2 = "**Intervention** N = {n}")

# to output to .docx:
# tbl %>%
#   as_flex_table() %>%
#   flextable::save_as_docx()
```

<br> <br>

### **Table 2:** Characteristics of patients in the control arm, overall and by site

```{r}
#create demographic table of control arm by site
empro_data %>%
  filter(arm == "control") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site,
         age_baseline,
         race_gp,
         diag_enroll,
         year_emp_enrollment,
         enrollment_month1,
         crpc_per,
         education,
         yn_eortc_0,
         yn_eortc_3,
         yn_eortc_6,
         yn_eortc_9,
         yn_eortc_12,
         eortc_0,
         eortc_3,
         eortc_6,
         eortc_9,
         eortc_12,
         dead
         ) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = site,
              missing = "ifany",
              missing_text = "N missing",
              type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
              statistic = all_continuous() ~ c("{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                                               "{min}, {max}")) %>%
  gtsummary::add_overall() %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_header(label = "")

# to output to .docx:
# tbl %>%
#   as_flex_table() %>%
#   flextable::save_as_docx()
```

<br> <br>

### **Table 4:** Secondary outcomes of patients in the intervention arm, overall and by site

```{r}
#create table of secondary outcomes for intervention arm by site
empro_data %>%
  filter(arm == "intervention") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site,
         clinician_contact,
         n_visit_soft_trigger,
         n_total_soft_trigger,
         n_visit_hard_trigger,
         n_total_hard_trigger,
         pain_hard_trigger) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = site,
              missing = "ifany",
              missing_text = "N missing",
              type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
              statistic = all_continuous() ~ c("{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                                               "{min}, {max}")) %>%
  gtsummary::add_overall() %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_header(label = "")
```
